summary: Iter-30 verifies four new features: team composer with files (POST /api/teams/{id}/start-with-files), asset link adder (POST /api/orgs/{id}/asset-links) with provider auto-detect, PATCH /api/conversations/{id}/settings, and smart_expand-on-direct chats promoting to group. 16 new pytest cases — all PASS (16/16). Backend coverage: file upload + text routing, file-only routing, multipart error, Google Drive / Dropbox / Notion / Figma provider detection, non-http rejection, empty URL rejection, asset listing, creator delete, non-uploader-non-admin 403, all three PATCH branches (auto_respond, smart_expand, both), and smart_expand direct-chat promotion (verified the conv flips to type=group + new specialist added + system 'joined the room' message persisted). Frontend selectors all exist in source — conv-toggle-auto-respond + conv-toggle-smart-expand chips render in green-tinted ON state on a live Chief-of-Staff conversation (verified via screenshot).
action_items: Main agent can self-verify the Asset Library link form (data-testid='asset-link-form') renders on /app/org/{orgId} — preview testing landed straight into the General Chief-of-Staff chat on org navigation (likely the OrgPage redirects when the org has an active CoS thread). Confirm the asset library section is reachable from the org landing for fresh orgs, OR document the redirect behaviour.

Frontend Feature 1/3 navigation flow (Team page Smart-Start composer auto-nav after Send) was not directly exercised because the preview /app/team/{id} URL pattern in this org resolved to /app/team/{id}/c/{cid} (a conversation deep-link) rather than the team root composer. Backend endpoint is fully verified; main agent should sanity-check that the TeamPage root view still renders for users without an existing conversation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:5707 smart_start_with_files routes by file names when text is empty — good UX. Routing text uses up to 6 file names. Consider lowering for huge file dumps.

server.py:5140-5186 smart_expand-direct block: the system 'joined the room' insert is wrapped in try/except pass — if it fails the conv state still mutates (type=group, new agent added) but the user has no signal a new agent joined. Consider logging on except.

server.py:7591 add_asset_link: 'Any org member can add' — note this is broader than the existing file upload permission only if the file-upload path is itself any-member. Confirmed parity by reading upload_asset.
server.py:7546-7581 _LINK_PROVIDER_HOSTS is a great extensible table; .endswith('.'+h) handles subdomain matches correctly.

server.py:5786 update_conversation_settings: PATCH with empty body returns the current conv (used as a poor-man's GET in tests). Consider adding a dedicated GET /conversations/{id} for clearer semantics.

success_rate.frontend: Partial — all required data-testids exist in source; conv-toggle chips visually verified in green-ON state on live conv; asset-link-form + smart-start-attach-btn could not be visually exercised in this run due to preview-account routing landing into existing conversations rather than the org/team root views.
